name: Grave Influence
body:
School necromancy [language-dependent]; Level cleric/oracle 5, sorcerer/wizard 6

EFFECT

Targets one undead/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart

DESCRIPTION

As mass suggestion.
